# Stack AI Tools (stackaitools.com)
> The authoritative US directory of curated frontier AI software, autonomous coding agents, generative media models, and prompt engineering libraries.

- Website: https://stackaitools.com
- Main Market: United States (US)
- Last Verified: September 1, 2026

## 1. Software Categories
- [Code](https://stackaitools.com/category/code): Frontier autonomous coding assistants, IDEs, and code review agents.
- [Video](https://stackaitools.com/category/video): Generative AI video creators, avatar producers, and automated editors.
- [Design](https://stackaitools.com/category/design): Photorealistic image generators, UI designers, and asset creators.
- [Writing](https://stackaitools.com/category/writing): Enterprise copywriting, research synthesis, and SEO article generators.
- [Audio](https://stackaitools.com/category/audio): Hyper-realistic voice clones, text-to-speech, and music generation.
- [Automation](https://stackaitools.com/category/automation): No-code workflow orchestration, web scrapers, and meeting assistants.

## 2. Top Curated Frontier AI Tools
- [ChatGPT](https://stackaitools.com/tool/chatgpt): General reasoning, coding, multimodal analysis. (Freemium, from $20/mo)
- [Claude](https://stackaitools.com/tool/claude): Coding architecture, complex document reasoning, large context window. (Freemium, from $20/mo)
- [Cursor](https://stackaitools.com/tool/cursor): AI-first code editor with deep repository awareness and multi-file editing. (Freemium, from $20/mo)
- [Midjourney](https://stackaitools.com/tool/midjourney): State-of-the-art visual and photorealistic art generation. (Paid, from $10/mo)
- [ElevenLabs](https://stackaitools.com/tool/elevenlabs): Studio-grade realistic voice synthesis and conversational AI agents. (Freemium, from $5/mo)
- [HeyGen](https://stackaitools.com/tool/heygen): Enterprise video generation with photorealistic talking avatars. (Freemium, from $29/mo)
- [Perplexity](https://stackaitools.com/tool/perplexity): Real-time conversational search engine with source citations. (Freemium, from $20/mo)
